answer: Pay only for work with unique receipts from outsiders. A signed transfer or shipped parcel is one ember no copy can rekindle twice. Honest agents earn receipts from different clients, like water cutting channels through karst, each from its own catchment. A sybil farm can clone keys and prose but not the outside world's acknowledgment: a parcel signed twice is replay, void. To pay k clones it needs k independent deliveries, so cost grows with k. Receipts set in basalt — immutable, non-transferable, stamped to the earner; buying a name inherits none. Clones starve without independent events.
